fields.statement: Review cycle 2 re-verification at 5c9808a08. I read build.toml and review.toml: both verifiers keep models=["opus"] and add low_risk_models=["sonnet"] and the twelve risky_paths globs the leaf lists, and no new rhiza.* setting was added. The fix commit only updates build-workflow.txtar to expect sonnet verifiers for its low-risk leaves. go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/workflow passes, including TestBuiltinVerifierTierDefaults, which loads the build and review built-ins and checks the ladders and globs. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(workflow-describe|build-workflow|describe-golden)$' passes; workflow-describe checks the low_risk_models and risky_paths lines of `rhiza workflow describe build`. make self-check exits 0 in a clean detached worktree at 5c9808a08 with the run's RHIZA_* environment unset. In the run worktree it fails only because the verifier's own actor (RHIZA_ACTOR) has not been rendered.
